newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-H.Smith rises after strong half result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-H.Smith rises after strong half result.

text.p: The shares of shipping, engineering and hardware group Howard Smith Ltd found higher levels at midday on Tuesday after the company announced a 56.8 percent jump in first half earnings to A$61.3 million.
At 12.30 p.m (0130 GMT), Howard Smith shares were 25 cents higher at A$11.25 on turnover of 262,874 shares.

The company's below the line earnings were boosted by an abnormal gain of A$14.4 million which came mostly from the sale of its tanker Canopus, sold during the period following its decision to withdraw from shipping.
"Howard Smith has been a very strong performer in the last 12 months and its result today was at the high end of expectations," a Sydney-based dealer said.
The dealer said the market was also pleased that the company had lowered its gearing and lifted its dividend.
